description: Create a purchase order and SEND it to the vendor — it opens when they approve. approved:true only records a PO the vendor already agreed to off-platform.

vendor.description: The seller — the vendor's gerp_id (cross-firm) or contact_id (self-approved).

description.description: What was ordered, e.g. "10 bags espresso beans".

account.description: Debit account at receipt; defaults INVENTORY.

accountType.description: ASSET (stock), EXPENSE (services/supplies), or EQUITY (a migrated opening bill).

item_id.description: The inventory item this line buys. Set it and receiving the PO also moves the shelf count, not just the money.

qty.description: Units on this line. Sent to the vendor and part of the agreed terms; with item_id it also sizes the receipt.

sku.description: The VENDOR's item id for this line, from their published inventory. Sent to the vendor so their rules can answer from the shelf.

approved.description: True ONLY when the VENDOR has already agreed off-platform (phoned in, confirmed by email) — it opens the PO now with no approval sent. The owner telling you to place the order is NOT this: leave it unset so the order goes to the vendor and their own approval opens it.

thread.description: Existing PO thread to counter/amend against; omit to open a new one.

memo.description: Optional note, written as a TEMPLATE: put $1, $2 … where a name or anything else specific to your firm would go and pass those values in private_values. This PO crosses to the vendor, so the memo travels; private_values does not.

job.description: Optional job tag — the PO's receipts/payments carry it into journal dimensions for per-job cost.

private_values.description: What memo's $1, $2 … stand for, in order — one value per placeholder, no gaps. Stays on your row; never sent to the vendor.
